decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.The proposed rear roof extension, by reason of its size, position and appearance would be unduly obtrusive and would detract from the design, scale and character of the house and the locality contrary to policies: ENV-B.1.1. (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Residential Extensions.

Condition : 2 - 2.The design, bulk and massing of the proposed extension would be out of character with surrounding development and would represent an intrusive, ungainly and overbearing structure, which would be detrimental to the character of the area and the outlook from neighbouring residential properties and would harm the character and appearance of the Strand on the Green Conservation Area contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1. (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Residential Extensions
description: Erection of a rear roof extension incorporating two front rooflights to the house.
